recent_changes.description: Action Hub 2.0: Restructured tools into a 2-row grid for better accessibility and cleaner header.

Content Normalization: Implemented
tag removal during JSON import and rendering to fix 'txt lỗi' issues.
TTS Stability: Added timeout handling and empty segment filtering to prevent infinite loading states.
